findings.oracle: Real DSL '_SIMPLE_STRUCT' -> HexPatCompiler.compile; oracle=exact known template dict; test_compile_simple_struct_full_json_structure asserts parsed==full {name,description,default_endianness,fields[3 with exact field_type]} .
Same compile output folded into test_compile_simple_struct_full_json_structure asserting the whole dict incl name='Header', not just the name key.
test_compile_simple_struct_full_json_structure asserts exact fields list (magic/version/flags with UInt32/16/8), not mere key existence.
test_compile_simple_struct_parses_real_bytes drives struct.pack('<IHB') through Rust runtime asserting exact (name,offset,size) per field and display_values.
test_compile_to_dict_full_top_level_structure asserts exact name/description/default_endianness/field-name order and absence of types/author/magic_detection.
test_compile_to_dict_full_top_level_structure asserts exact key VALUES not just presence.
test_compile_multi_field_struct_types_and_parse asserts (name,type) for u8/16/32/64 then packs '<BHIQ' through Rust runtime asserting exact offsets/sizes/display_values.
test_compile_array_field_structure_and_parse asserts exact Array field_type {element_type UInt8,count 4} and parses 4 bytes asserting each child [0..3] offset+display_value via runtime.
test_compile_enum_values_and_resolves_name asserts types['Format'] full enum dict + JSON values + runtime resolves 0x89->'PNG (137, 0x89)' and 0xFF->'JPEG (255, 0xFF)'.
test_compile_union_overlays_fields asserts exact union types['Value'] dict (as_int UInt32 / as_float Float32) and float<->int overlay via struct oracle.
test_compile_bitfield_entries asserts exact bitfield fields [(bit0,1),(bit1,1),(reserved,6)], width sum==8, and JSON values.
test_compile_endianness_changes_decoded_value asserts endianness metadata then parses 0x1234(le) vs 0x05(be) bytes via runtime, proving endianness flips decoded ints.
test_compile_nested_struct_resolves_and_parses asserts StructRef field_type + runtime nests Inner children (x=0x11,y=0x22) and places extra at offset 2.
test_compile_syntax_error_missing_semicolon_raises_with_diagnostics asserts HexPatError.message=="Expected ';', got '}'", line=1, column=19, str()='<input>:1:19:...'.
test_compile_empty_source_raises_no_struct asserts HexPatError.message=='no struct declaration found' and exact str().
test_compile_if_else_eq_partitions_on_value asserts Eq/Ne condition params then executes both branches via runtime (flag==1->a=0xCAFEBABE; flag==2->b=0xBEEF).
test_compile_if_else_bitmask_partitions_on_bit asserts BitAnd/BitAndZero(4) then runtime: bit set->a, bit clear->b with exact values.
test_compile_if_only_bitmask_selects_or_omits_branch asserts single BitAnd(8) then runtime includes a iff bit set, omits otherwise.
test_tokenize_full_sequence_with_positions asserts the complete ordered (type,value,line,column) token list for 'struct Foo { u8 bar; };'.
test_tokenize_terminates_with_single_eof asserts last token EOF AND exactly one EOF in stream (not just final type).
test_tokenize_keyword_vs_identifier_classification asserts STRUCT/U8 counts and that 'struct'/'u8' are NOT identifiers, with exact identifier list.
test_tokenize_identifiers_in_order_and_context asserts identifiers==[('Foo',1,8),('bar',1,17)] with exact positions/order.
test_tokenize_hex_number_value_and_position asserts single NUMBER token value '255', column 28, and preceding ASSIGN token.
test_tokenize_line_numbers_for_every_token asserts (type,line,column) for ALL tokens across a 3-line source.
